_comment: RIGHTBREED v4 — G5 training-effort risk gate. DRAFT, PENDING VET SIGN-OFF.
Source: Coren, S. (1994/2006), 'The Intelligence of Dogs' — a survey of 199
AKC/CKC obedience judges, NOT a peer-reviewed journal study. Bucketed using
Coren's own published tier bands: EASY = ranks 1-26 (Brightest + Excellent
Working), MODERATE = ranks 27-54 (Above Average + Average), HARD = ranks
55-79 (Fair + Lowest Degree). NO_DATA = the breed has never competed in an
AKC/CKC obedience trial, so no ranking of comparable rigor exists anywhere —
this is a genuine literature gap, not evidence of poor trainability, and it
NEVER carries a penalty (see 'NO_DATA' row below: always 1.00).
Every breed in breeds.json must appear in `breeds` or the build FAILS
(scripts/validate-data.mjs). Multipliers apply to the base score:
final = base x G1 x G2 x G3 x G4 x G5. Kept at the SAME severity scale as
G3 (experience) on explicit instruction — this factor has real survey data
behind it and should not be softened the way the weaker-evidenced G6 was.

CHANGED 29 Sep: Coren measures how fast a breed LEARNS in obedience trials, not how much training it NEEDS. Two groups were getting no penalty for a 'minimal training' owner when they should: (1) GUARDIAN_ONGOING — Rottweiler, Doberman, German Shepherd learn fast but, as large protective breeds, need lifelong training and socialisation regardless; (2) INDEPENDENT_HOUND — Mudhol Hound and Rajapalayam have no Coren rank (NO_DATA), but independent sighthound temperament is well described and the DB marks both 'Experienced only'. NO_DATA still means no penalty for every other breed. PENDING VET/TRAINER SIGN-OFF, like the rest of this file.

classReasons.EASY: Coren rank in the top third — learns quickly, minimal effort needed
classReasons.MODERATE: Coren rank in the middle third — responds well with regular training
classReasons.HARD: Coren rank in the bottom third — genuinely needs sustained training effort
classReasons.NO_DATA: never evaluated in AKC/CKC obedience trials — no ranking exists, so no penalty applies
classReasons.GUARDIAN_ONGOING: learns quickly, but a large protective breed needs ongoing training and socialisation for life — minimal effort is a safety risk, not just an inconvenience
classReasons.INDEPENDENT_HOUND: never obedience-ranked, but an independent sighthound — recall and obedience take sustained, patient work
